title: John Alexander at Romanek's house: the flashlight answers questions

tellings.quote: "Well, we went in the backyard and he took the flashlight and he unscrews the flashlight till, you know, it's sort of on on off and it's off and puts them on the picnic table and then Roman starts asking questions and the flashlight starts asking the questions."

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron relays a story from John Alexander, a researcher of the paranormal, about a visit to the Colorado home of a man named Stan Romanek. According to Alexander, they went into the backyard, Romanek unscrewed a flashlight until it sat right between on and off, set it on a picnic table, and began asking questions, and the flashlight seemed to answer by switching on. If true, it would suggest some unseen intelligence was responding to them.
